es: Analizar un cartel ajeno, crear un eslogan con una técnica de persuasión y presentar una campaña vecinal con pregunta retórica, énfasis y llamada a la acción.

teaching.en: The poster's headline uses contrast: noisy streets, quiet minds.
teaching.es: El titular del cartel usa el contraste: calles ruidosas, mentes tranquilas.
teaching.explanationEs: Analiza el titular: nombra la técnica y explica su efecto.
teaching.audioText: The poster's headline uses contrast: noisy streets, quiet minds.

teaching.en: Our campaign aims to plant thirty trees in the neighbourhood.
teaching.es: Nuestra campaña pretende plantar treinta árboles en el barrio.
teaching.explanationEs: Aim to + verbo: el objetivo de la campaña.
teaching.audioText: Our campaign aims to plant thirty trees in the neighbourhood.

teaching.en: The picture of a child makes the poster appeal to parents.
teaching.es: La imagen de un niño hace que el cartel apele a los padres.
teaching.explanationEs: Appeal to + personas: una imagen también persuade.

teaching.audioText: The picture of a child makes the poster appeal to parents.

teaching.en: In my pitch, I will open with a question and close with a call to action.
teaching.es: En mi presentación abriré con una pregunta y cerraré con una llamada a la acción.
teaching.explanationEs: Un pitch breve tiene apertura, desarrollo y cierre.

question and close with a call to action.

teaching.en: Every volunteer will meet at the park on Saturday.

prompt.es: Elige el análisis correcto del titular del cartel.

choices.text: The headline uses repetition to catch the eye.
The headline uses contrast to catch the eye.
The headline asks a rhetorical question to catch the eye.

feedback.es: Empty y full se oponen: es un contraste; no hay palabra repetida ni pregunta.

hint.es: Busca dos ideas opuestas en el titular.

prompt.es: Completa: «Nuestra campaña quiere mejorar el barrio.»

feedback.es: El objetivo de la campaña se expresa con to + verbo.

hint.es: Aquí va el infinitivo con to, no for.

origin.text: Our campaign is ___ improve the neighbourhood.

answer.text: Every volunteer will bring a bag

feedback.es: La llamada a la acción es concreta: cada voluntario y lo que debe hacer.

prompt.es: Elige el eslogan que usa un tricolon correcto.

choices.text: Clean parks, safe streets, we are happy neighbours.
Clean parks, safe streets and neighbours happy.
Clean parks, safe streets, happy neighbours.

feedback.es: El tricolon mantiene la misma forma (adjetivo + nombre plural) en las tres partes.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada parte del pitch con su función.

pairs: Would you let your child play here?
It is such a clean park that visitors smile.
Join us on Saturday at nine.

feedback.es: La pregunta abre, such da énfasis y la invitación concreta cierra el pitch.

answer.text: It is such a nice neighbourhood.
accepted: It is such a nice neighbourhood.

feedback.es: Con a + adjetivo + nombre singular se usa such a: such a nice neighbourhood.

origin.text: It is a very nice neighbourhood.

prompt.es: Analiza el titular del cartel: elige técnica y efecto.

choices.text: It asks a rhetorical question to make parents feel worried.
It repeats one word to make the slogan memorable.
It uses contrast to compare two neighbourhoods.

feedback.es: El titular formula una pregunta cuya respuesta es obvia y busca preocupar a los padres.

origin.text: Why should our children breathe smoke?

prompt.es: Ordena el eslogan: «Parques seguros, aire limpio, familias felices.»

answer.text: Safe parks, clean air, happy families

feedback.es: Tricolon: tres partes con la misma forma (adjetivo + nombre plural).

prompt.es: Escucha el pitch y elige la llamada a la acción.

choices.text: Write a letter to the newspaper on Sunday.
Go to the park on Saturday and add your name.
Call the council office on Monday morning.

feedback.es: El pitch termina pidiendo ir al parque el sábado y firmar la lista: quién, dónde y cuándo.

origin.audio: Why should our children cross a busy road every day? This neighbourhood needs a safe crossing. So on Saturday at ten, come to the park and sign the list.

prompt.es: Analiza el cartel y presenta tu campaña (80-150 palabras).

answer.text: The poster uses contrast in its headline, loud streets and quiet children, to catch the eye, and the picture of a child makes parents feel worried. Our slogan is: safe streets, happy children, stronger neighbourhoods. We want to build a safe crossing near the school. Why should our children cross such a busy road every day? The traffic is so heavy that parents are afraid to walk. Every volunteer can help: join us on Saturday at ten, bring a friend and sign the petition. Together we can make our neighbourhood safer.
accepted: The poster uses contrast in its headline, loud streets and quiet children, to catch the eye, and the picture of a child makes parents feel worried. Our slogan is: safe streets, happy children, stronger neighbourhoods. We want to build a safe crossing near the school. Why should our children cross such a busy road every day? The traffic is so heavy that parents are afraid to walk. Every volunteer can help: join us on Saturday at ten, bring a friend and sign the petition. Together we can make our neighbourhood safer.

The headline of this poster uses contrast to catch the eye of parents: loud streets against quiet children. The picture also appeals to their feelings. Our slogan is: fewer cars, cleaner air, safer children. Our campaign is to build a safe crossing near the school. Who wants to see a child cross such a dangerous road? The traffic is so heavy that nobody feels safe. Please join us on Saturday at ten, every volunteer is welcome, and sign the petition before you leave.

feedback.es: Un caso completo analiza el cartel, propone un eslogan con técnica y cierra con una presentación persuasiva y una petición concreta.

origin.text: Caso: un cartel del barrio con el titular «Loud streets, quiet children» y la imagen de un niño junto a una calle con mucho tráfico. Escribe: 1) la técnica del cartel y su efecto; 2) un eslogan propio con una técnica; 3) un pitch breve con pregunta retórica, so o such y una llamada a la acción.

prompt.es: Elige el análisis correcto de este titular.

choices.text: It uses a tricolon of three matching verbs.
It uses a rhetorical question to involve the audience.
It uses antithesis: two opposite ideas in the same structure.

feedback.es: Not… but… enfrenta dos ideas opuestas con la misma estructura: antítesis.

origin.text: Not more cars, but more life.

prompt.es: Completa: «Es un problema tan serio que debemos actuar hoy.»

feedback.es: Delante de a + adjetivo + nombre se usa such.

origin.text: It is ___ a serious problem that we must act today.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Cada voluntario firmará la petición el sábado.»

answer.text: Every volunteer will sign the petition on Saturday

feedback.es: Sujeto + will + verbo + complemento de lugar y tiempo: una llamada a la acción concreta.
